Resolves #21302

Fixes the intermittent `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:205` `waitForStageTop` timeout (`diff = -32px` at `900×700`) exposed by `#21293` (`d254125da4`), where `.neo-h3` rendered in fallback `sans-serif` (4 lines, `heroH = 692px`) while `Source Sans 3` (`display=swap`) was still loading and shrank to 3 lines (`heroH = 660px`) mid-scroll. `scrollHomeToReference` now waits for injected stylesheets (`Boolean(link.sheet)` + `Source Sans 3`) and `document.fonts.ready` before starting smooth scroll.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright `playwright.config.e2e.mjs` runs on exact head `fda5d0a184` + `250ms` synthetic `gstatic.com` font-delay verification) → L2 required (AC-1 and AC-2 cover Playwright E2E synchronization). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — adds `waitForHomeStylesAndFonts(page)` before `scrollHomeToReference` smooth-scroll dispatch with zero runtime/product changes.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs`: `waitForHomeStylesAndFonts` polls for `.portal-home-hero-content .neo-h3` (`Source Sans 3`), `.portal-home-parts-audiencedoors`, and `link[rel="stylesheet"].sheet` readiness, awaits `document.fonts.ready`, and runs inside `scrollHomeToReference` before `scrollToPart`. |
| AC-2 | Local Chrome E2E (`fda5d0a184`): `3 passed (16.3s)` (after `6 passed (28.9s)` on pre-rebase `--repeat-each=2` at `22d3be322e`); under simulated `250ms` `fonts.gstatic.com` delay, baseline landed at `scrollTop: 692, diff: -32` whereas `link.sheet` + `document.fonts.ready` landed at `scrollTop: 660, diff: 0`. Hosted Linux CI runs on this PR. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive (`waitForHomeStylesAndFonts` checks `.portal-home-hero-content .neo-h3` computed font rather than `document.body`, since `Global.css:86` applies `--core-fontfamily-sans` directly to `h1, h2, h3` and `p`).

## Reviews

### `@neo-fable-mnemosyne` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-18T05:10:01Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — test-only: one helper and one call in an existing e2e spec, no product code, no consumed contract.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that `scrollHomeToReference` started its smooth scroll while the hero still stood in the fallback face, so the target moved by 32 px under it. I read the spec at the exact head `fda5d0a184` against neo #21302: the new `waitForHomeStylesAndFonts` waits for the hero copy, the doors, every `link[rel="stylesheet"]` with a loaded `sheet`, then `document.fonts.ready`, and runs before `scrollToPart`. `waitForStageTop` keeps its 4 px tolerance, no fixed sleep is added, and the delta from the ticket (the hero's `.neo-h3` instead of `body`) is named with its reason. All fifteen `e2e-engine` shards pass at this head, and the author's 250 ms font-delay probe shows the race without the gate (`diff: -32`) and none with it. What I looked for and did not find in that evidence: a run in which `document.fonts.ready` is already resolved because the face's load has not started yet (the computed `fontFamily` is the declared stack, not the face in use). A forced layout read, or `document.fonts.load('1em "Source Sans 3"')`, before awaiting `ready` would close that window by construction; optional polish, no return cycle. The repair touches no site the ticket did not name.

**Findings:** None.

The product symptom behind the race (the Home's first screen jumps when the web font arrives) is out of this ticket's scope by its own text; it is recorded as defect-note `6384547f` for the Home's and the fonts' owners.
